result.brief: 提出四叉树视觉 tokenizer，按视觉复杂度动态分配表征容量，兼顾 2D 空间绑定与 1D 序列因果性，并支持自回归图像生成与零样本空间控制。
result.reason: Quadtree visual tokenizer with hierarchical latent allocation and autoregressive generation; tokenizer/representation design is directly relevant to RAE and generative latent spaces, though image-only.
